description: The TRANSFERS table contains data on patient transfers within the hospital, including admissions, discharges, and transfers between different care units and wards. It provides timestamps for arrival and departure (INTIME, OUTTIME) and calculates the length of stay (LOS) for each transfer event. The table links to other patient data via SUBJECT_ID, HADM_ID, and ICUSTAY_ID, and specifies the data source (DBSOURCE) and type of event (EVENTTYPE). This table allows tracking patient movement and resource utilization within the hospital.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: Source database for the event, such as 'carevue' or 'metavision'.

columns.name: PREV_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's previous care unit, such as 'SICU' (Surgical Intensive Care Unit).

columns.name: CURR_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's current care unit, such as 'SICU' (Surgical Intensive Care Unit).

columns.name: PREV_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's previous ward.

columns.name: CURR_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's current ward.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The timestamp of when the patient was admitted.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The timestamp of when the patient was discharged.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: Length of stay, calculated as the duration between INTIME and OUTTIME, measured in days.
